item.title: Andrea De Silva on the magic of Phagwa | Portfolio | Caribbean Beat Magazine
item.description: Award-winning photojournalist Andrea De Silva shares some of her favourite images from Phagwa or Holi — the Hindu festival of colours, celebrating love, spring, and the triumph of good over evil — as told to Shelly-Ann Inniss

item.title: Kimberly Forrester doesn’t miss a beet | Cookup | Caribbean Beat Magazine
item.description: Trinidadian wellness practitioner Kimberly Forrester has used her own experience of recovering from health challenges to help empower her clients to do the same. Now with her new cookbook, she’s not just sharing her passion for sustainably healthy eating, as Franka Philip learns — but the magic of beetroot

item.title: John Jones: Champion of Change | Caribbean Beat Magazine
item.description: "The Bajan Farmer" John Jones — director of Thirteen Acre Farms in Barbados, which he acquired in 2022 with a mission to address the island’s heavy reliance on imported food — has been named the 2026 recipient of the Champions of Change Award, sponsored by illycaffè, presented as part of North America’s 50 Best Restaurants
